The '''Rarririans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. About 200 Rarririans lived on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Port Tooga]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
